definition.title: How these figures are counted
definition.eligible: Eligible: approved, not reversed, not a confirmed audit issue; counted in its sale month if approved by the payroll cutoff.
definition.eligibleLong: Eligible sales: approved, not reversed, not linked to a Confirmed-issue audit case, and a sale (never a product switch). A sale counts in the month it was submitted if it is approved by the end of day {day} of the next month; otherwise it counts in the month it was approved.
definition.submitted: Submitted: every sale not rejected or reversed — approved or still waiting for approval.
definition.revenue: Revenue is the amount collected: monthly recharge × months paid + installation fee (USD).
definition.periods: Monthly views (this month, previous month, year to date) use the eligible rule. Today, this week and a custom range count approved sales by the day they were submitted.
definition.target: City target = active Sales Agents and Team Leaders of the city × {units} units (Settings). Individual agent targets come in Phase 14.
definition.branch: A sale's branch is where the money was handed in, so a branch can collect sales from another city.

hints.temp_base_salary: One flat monthly amount for every temporary agent (no pro-rating, D-08).
hints.incentive_threshold: Incentive = MAX(0, eligible units − this number) × rate.
hints.incentive_rate: Paid for each eligible unit above the threshold.
hints.payroll_cutoff_day: Day of the next month after which a payroll month can be finalized (1–28).
hints.free_month_amount: Amount recorded for a free-month sale.
hints.allowed_phone_prefixes: Comma-separated, e.g. 063, 065. Leave empty to accept any Somaliland mobile number.
hints.performance_target_units: Agents at or above this number are "Target met".
hints.performance_baseline_units: Agents from this number up to the target are "Baseline"; below it, "Underperforming". Must be lower than the target.
hints.week_start_day: First day of the week in weekly reports and charts.
hints.weekend_days: Not counted as working days for leave.
hints.otp_enabled: When on, every user enters a 6-digit SMS code after their password. Turn off only in an emergency.

settings.branchesIntro: Branches are where agents hand in the money they collect. The branch is chosen on each sale (D-31).

settings.holidaysIntro: Public holidays are not counted as working days for leave.

stock.title: stock
stock.overviewIntro: Stock is counted by quantity (no serial numbers, D-35). The Stock Officer issues stock to an Outdoor Supervisor; it counts for the Supervisor's team once the Supervisor (or Super Admin) accepts it. Each sale by the team takes the chosen items from that stock.
stock.toAcceptIntro: Check the items arrived, then accept. Only accepted stock can be used for sales.
stock.receiveIntro: Stock delivered to the Central Store. Enter the quantity of each item received.
stock.sendIntro: Issue stock from the Central Store to an Outdoor Supervisor. It counts for the Supervisor's team once the Supervisor (or Super Admin) accepts.
stock.returnIntro: Only the Stock Officer records returns, after receiving the equipment.
stock.markFaulty: Put in the faulty store (not usable)
stock.adjustmentsIntro: For lost, damaged or miscounted stock. The Stock Officer requests; Super Admin approves. Nobody approves their own request.
stock.changeHint: Negative to remove (e.g. −2), positive to add.
stock.reportIntro: Per location and item for the chosen dates. Closing = opening + received + transferred in − transferred out − issued to customers + returned in − returned out ± adjustments.
stock.historyIntro: Every stock movement, newest first (last 300). Movements can never be changed or deleted.
stock.sent: Stock issued. The Outdoor Supervisor must accept it.
stock.accepted: Accepted. The stock now counts for the Supervisor's team.
stock.cancelled: Cancelled. The stock is back in the Central Store.
stock.adjustmentRequested: Adjustment requested. Super Admin must approve it.
stock.receivedOk: Stock received into the Central Store.

audit.title: audit
audit.intro: Duplicate attempts and other rule hits are grouped into cases. A case is a risk indicator, not proof of fraud: only a reviewer sets Confirmed Issue. Open and Under Review cases put the agent's pay on hold; Confirmed Issue makes the linked sales ineligible; False Positive has no effect.
audit.eventsIntro: Every rule hit, newest first. Events are kept for good and can never be changed or deleted.
audit.rulesIntro: Core duplicate rules are always on. Super Admin can switch the other rules on or off and change their limits; every change is recorded.

effects.hold: Linked agents' pay is on hold while the case is open or under review.
effects.confirmed: Linked sales are ineligible (not counted for incentive).
effects.none: No effect on sales or pay.

audit.readOnly: Only Super Admin or the Auditor assigned to this case can change it.

DUP_PHONE.name: Duplicate phone number
DUP_PHONE.explain: A New sale used a phone number that already belongs to a customer. The sale was blocked.

DUP_INDEX.name: Duplicate Index Number
DUP_INDEX.explain: A New sale used an Index Number that already belongs to a customer. The sale was blocked.

IDENTITY_CONFLICT.name: Identity conflict
IDENTITY_CONFLICT.explain: A Retention sale used a phone and Index of different customers, or a name that does not match. The sale was blocked.

SAME_MONTH.name: Second sale in the same month
SAME_MONTH.explain: A sale was attempted for a customer who already has a sale this month. The sale was blocked.

SWITCH_MISMATCH.name: Product switch mismatch
SWITCH_MISMATCH.explain: A product switch used details that do not match one existing customer and product. The switch was blocked.

MULTI_AGENT_ATTEMPT.name: Several agents, same customer
MULTI_AGENT_ATTEMPT.explain: A customer registered as New by one agent was tried again by a different agent within a short period. Normal Retention sales are not counted; only the agent who made the attempt is put on hold.

BURST.name: Too many sales too fast
BURST.explain: One agent registered many sales within a few minutes.

POST_APPROVAL_EDIT.name: Edit after approval
POST_APPROVAL_EDIT.explain: An approved sale itself was changed after approval. The system never does this, so it is a red flag.

IDENTITY_CORRECTED.name: Customer details corrected
IDENTITY_CORRECTED.explain: Super Admin corrected the phone, Index or name of a customer with an approved sale, with a reason. Recorded for review only: no case, no hold.

SELF_APPROVED.name: Self-approved sale
SELF_APPROVED.explain: A Team Leader approved their own sale (allowed, D-40). Recorded for review only: no case, no hold.
